messages:
jamal: hey all 1 1 first day remote — quick question: where do i post different types of requests? examples: asking for a short-term GCP role, ordering a monitor, inviting the standup bot, or posting a note about who to cc for repo access. thanks! :wave:
devex: welcome Jamal! :tada: high-level: social stuff -> #random or #lunch-plans; access or infra stuff -> #help (or tag #eng-infra if it's infra-specific); hardware -> #people-ops. include manager in the thread for approvals.
infra-team: for GCP roles please post in #eng-infra with `ACCESS REQUEST` in caps and include your email, org unit, and duration. e.g. `ACCESS REQUEST: GCP BigQuery-Reader for jamal@redwood.com until 2026-04-20`. We try to make them temporary by default.
people-ops: monitors/peripherals: open the Equipment form (pinned in #people-ops) and then post a short slack message tagging @people-ops for pickup scheduling. we can usually ship next-day for US offices.
marie: standup/meeting bots: try `/invite @standup-bot` in the channel you want it in. if you see a permissions error, mention @devex and we'll request workspace-admin to approve. for calendar integration, include your calendar email.
onboarding-bot: Hi Jamal! To finish provisioning faster, run `onboard done` in DM with @devex and confirm your manager. See https://intranet.redwood/onboarding for checklist.
jamal: super helpful. one more: if i post a repo access request in #help, should i include ticket template fields or just paste the repo list?
devex: please use the template in the #help pinned messages: short reason, repo paths, manager approver, and desired ttl. putting `TTL: 30d` helps automation.
jamal: thanks — saved the template. appreciate the quick answers :heart:
